At the moment, we’re coming from a largely in-house solution, but with the increasing scale of our labeling operations we’re evaluating whether an external solution can give us more efficiency and stronger model integration / pre-labeling capabilities, while maintaining the security and privacy standards we currently have.

Concretely, it would be great to cover the following areas:

• 

Data privacy & security: Full control over data in our AWS S3 buckets, ideally via self-hosted deployment with no data leaving our environment.

• 

Data visualization & exploration: Scalable dataset browsing (10M+ images) with filtering, tagging, and metadata-based queries (e.g. confidence, embeddings, timestamps), plus the ability to send data directly into labeling workflows. Nice to have: embedding visualization and similarity search.

• 

Annotation capabilities: Support for bounding boxes, segmentation, keypoints, and classification, with a responsive UI (low latency, shortcuts), batch labeling, and multi-frame support.

• 

Pre-labeling & human-in-the-loop workflows: Integration with internal and external models, configurable pipelines (including multi-vote setups), batch pre-labeling, confidence-based routing, and review/audit loops with commenting.

• 

Workforce management: Role-based access (admin/annotator/reviewer), task assignment, and performance tracking (e.g. throughput, quality metrics).

• 

Dataset management & versioning: Ability to create datasets via filtered labels, visualize subsets, maintain version control, and track dataset lineage.

• 

API & SDK support: Python SDK, robust REST APIs for dataset/pipeline/annotation management, and webhooks for automation.
